chapterInfo.content:
19
Ɔsorofoɔ di ahurisie
1 # Adi 11.15 Yeinom akyiri no, metee biribi a ɛte sɛ nkurɔfoɔ pii nne kɛseɛ ɔsoro sɛ:
Haleluia!
Nkwagyeɛ ne animuonyam ne tumi yɛ yɛn Nyankopɔn dea;
2 # Adi 16.7; 6.10; Deut 32.43 ɛfiri sɛ n’atemmuo yɛ nokorɛ na ɛtene,
sɛ ɔbuu odwamamfoɔ kɛseɛ
a ɔde n’adwamammɔ asɛe asase no atɛn,
na ɔtɔɔ ne nkoa mogya so werɛ wɔ ne nsamu.
3 # Yes 34.10 Na wɔkaa bio sɛ:
Haleluia!
Na ne wisie foro soro daa daa.
4 # Adi 5.14; Dwom 106.48 Na mpanimfoɔ aduonu nnan ne ateasefoɔ baanan no koto sɔree Onyankopɔn a ɔte ahennwa no soɔ no sɛ:
Amen, Haleluia!
5Na ɛnne bi firii ahennwa no mu teaa mu sɛ:
Monyi yɛn Nyankopɔn ayɛ,
mo a moyɛ ne nkoa
ne mo a mosuro no nyinaa, akɛseɛ ne nketewa.
6 # Adi 11.15; 11.17 Na metee nne bi a ɛte sɛ nkurɔfokuo kɛseɛ nne, ne nsuo bebree nne, ne aprannaa a emu yɛ den nne sɛ:
Haleluia,
ɛfiri sɛ Awurade yɛn Nyankopɔn,
ade nyinaa so tumfoɔ no, adi hene.
7 # Dwom 118.24; Adi 21.2; 21.9 Momma yɛn ani nnye, na yɛnni ahurisie,
na yɛnhyɛ no animuonyam,
ɛfiri sɛ Adwammaa no ayeforɔhyia adu,
na ne yere asiesie ne ho.
8 # Dwom 45.13-14; Yes 61.10 Na wɔde nwera pa a
ɛhoa fitaa, a ɛho teɛ maa no sɛ ɔmfira.
Na nwera pa no ne ahotefoɔ tenenee.
9 # Luk 14.15 Na ɔka kyerɛɛ me sɛ: Twerɛ: Nhyira ne wɔn a wɔahyia wɔn adwammaa no ayeforɔ aseɛ. Na ɔka kyerɛɛ me sɛ: Nyankopɔn nsɛm a ɛyɛ nokorɛ nie. 10#Adi 22.8-9; Aso 10.25-26; Adi 12.17 Na mehwee ne nan ase mekotoo no. Na ɔka kyerɛɛ me sɛ: Hwɛ, nyɛ saa, meyɛ w’awurakwaa ne wo nuanom a wɔkura Yesu adanseɛ no mu bi. Koto Onyankopɔn! Na Yesu adanseɛ ne adiyie honhom no.
Ɔgyefoɔ no ho anisoadehunu kɛseɛ
11 # Adi 6.2; 1.5; 3.14; Yes 11.4-5 Na mehunuu sɛ ɔsoro abue, na hwɛ, ɔpɔnkɔ fitaa bi nie, na deɛ ɔte ne soɔ no, wɔfrɛ no Ɔseadeɛyɛ ne Ɔnokwafoɔ, na ɔbu atɛn, na ɔtu sa wɔ tenenee mu. 12#Adi 1.14; 2.18; 3.12 Na n’ani te sɛ ogyaframa, na ahemmotire pii bobɔ ne ti; na wɔatwerɛ ne din bi a obiara nnim gye ɔno nko. 13#Yes 63.1-2; Yoh 1.1 Na ɔhyɛ atadeɛ bi a wɔde abɔ mogya mu, na ne din de: Nyankopɔn Asɛm. 14#Adi 17.14 Na ɛdɔm a wɔwɔ soro no tete apɔnkɔ fitafitaa so di n’akyi hyehyɛ nwera pa fitaa a ɛho teɛ. 15#Adi 12.5; Dwom 2.9; Adi 14.19-20; Yes 63.3 Na afena nnamnnam bi firi n’anomu a ɔde bɛbobɔ amanaman, na ɔde dadeɛ poma bɛyɛne wɔn. Na ɔno na ɔtiatia Onyankopɔn, ade nyinaa so tumfoɔ no, abufuo a ɛyɛ den no nsa-kyi-amena no soɔ. 16#Adi 17.14; 1 Ti 6.15 Na ɔwɔ din bi a wɔatwerɛ n’atadeɛ ne n’asene mu sɛ: Ahene mu Hene ne awuranom mu Awurade.
Wɔdi aboa no ne n’asraafoɔ no so nkonim
17 # Hes 39.4; 39.17-20 Na mehunuu ɔbɔfoɔ bi a ɔgyina owia mu. Na ɔde nne kɛseɛ teaa mu ka kyerɛɛ nnomaa a wɔtu wɔ wiem nyinaa sɛ: Mommra mmɛhyia Nyankopɔn adidie kɛseɛ no ase 18mmɛdi ahemfo nam, asafohene nam, atumfoɔ nam, apɔnkɔ ne wɔn a wɔtete wɔn soɔ nam, adehyeɛ ne nkoa, nketewa ne akɛseɛ nyinaa nam. 19#Adi 17.12-14; 16.14; 16.16 Na mehunuu aboa no ne asase so ahemfo ne wɔn dɔm sɛ wɔaboaboa wɔn ano, na wɔne deɛ ɔte pɔnkɔ fitaa no soɔ no ne ne dɔm rebɛdi ako. 20#Adi 13.1; 13.11-17; 20.10; Dan 7.11; 7.26 Na wɔkyeree aboa no ne odiyifoɔ torofoɔ no nso a ɔyɛɛ n’anim nsɛnkyerɛnneɛ, de daadaa wɔn a wɔgyee aboa no agyiraeɛ ne wɔn a wɔkotoo ne honi no kaa ne ho. Wɔtoo wɔn baanu yi animono guu ogya tadeɛ a sɔfe dɛre mu no mu. 21Na wɔde deɛ ɔte pɔnkɔ no soɔ afena a ɛfiri n’anomu no kunkumm wɔn a aka no, na nnomaa nyinaa dii wɔn nam mee.

pageProps.chapterText:
Yeinom akyiri no, metee biribi a ɛte sɛ nkurɔfoɔ pii nne kɛseɛ ɔsoro sɛ:
Haleluia!
Nkwagyeɛ ne animuonyam ne tumi yɛ yɛn Nyankopɔn dea;
ɛfiri sɛ n’atemmuo yɛ nokorɛ na ɛtene,
sɛ ɔbuu odwamamfoɔ kɛseɛ
a ɔde n’adwamammɔ asɛe asase no atɛn,
na ɔtɔɔ ne nkoa mogya so werɛ wɔ ne nsamu.
Na wɔkaa bio sɛ:
Haleluia!
Na ne wisie foro soro daa daa.
Na mpanimfoɔ aduonu nnan ne ateasefoɔ baanan no koto sɔree Onyankopɔn a ɔte ahennwa no soɔ no sɛ:
Amen, Haleluia!
Na ɛnne bi firii ahennwa no mu teaa mu sɛ:
Monyi yɛn Nyankopɔn ayɛ,
mo a moyɛ ne nkoa
ne mo a mosuro no nyinaa, akɛseɛ ne nketewa.
Na metee nne bi a ɛte sɛ nkurɔfokuo kɛseɛ nne, ne nsuo bebree nne, ne aprannaa a emu yɛ den nne sɛ:
Haleluia,
ɛfiri sɛ Awurade yɛn Nyankopɔn,
ade nyinaa so tumfoɔ no, adi hene.
Momma yɛn ani nnye, na yɛnni ahurisie,
na yɛnhyɛ no animuonyam,
ɛfiri sɛ Adwammaa no ayeforɔhyia adu,
na ne yere asiesie ne ho.
Na wɔde nwera pa a
ɛhoa fitaa, a ɛho teɛ maa no sɛ ɔmfira.
Na nwera pa no ne ahotefoɔ tenenee.
Na ɔka kyerɛɛ me sɛ: Twerɛ: Nhyira ne wɔn a wɔahyia wɔn adwammaa no ayeforɔ aseɛ. Na ɔka kyerɛɛ me sɛ: Nyankopɔn nsɛm a ɛyɛ nokorɛ nie. Na mehwee ne nan ase mekotoo no. Na ɔka kyerɛɛ me sɛ: Hwɛ, nyɛ saa, meyɛ w’awurakwaa ne wo nuanom a wɔkura Yesu adanseɛ no mu bi. Koto Onyankopɔn! Na Yesu adanseɛ ne adiyie honhom no.

Na mehunuu sɛ ɔsoro abue, na hwɛ, ɔpɔnkɔ fitaa bi nie, na deɛ ɔte ne soɔ no, wɔfrɛ no Ɔseadeɛyɛ ne Ɔnokwafoɔ, na ɔbu atɛn, na ɔtu sa wɔ tenenee mu. Na n’ani te sɛ ogyaframa, na ahemmotire pii bobɔ ne ti; na wɔatwerɛ ne din bi a obiara nnim gye ɔno nko. Na ɔhyɛ atadeɛ bi a wɔde abɔ mogya mu, na ne din de: Nyankopɔn Asɛm. Na ɛdɔm a wɔwɔ soro no tete apɔnkɔ fitafitaa so di n’akyi hyehyɛ nwera pa fitaa a ɛho teɛ. Na afena nnamnnam bi firi n’anomu a ɔde bɛbobɔ amanaman, na ɔde dadeɛ poma bɛyɛne wɔn. Na ɔno na ɔtiatia Onyankopɔn, ade nyinaa so tumfoɔ no, abufuo a ɛyɛ den no nsa-kyi-amena no soɔ. Na ɔwɔ din bi a wɔatwerɛ n’atadeɛ ne n’asene mu sɛ: Ahene mu Hene ne awuranom mu Awurade.

Na mehunuu ɔbɔfoɔ bi a ɔgyina owia mu. Na ɔde nne kɛseɛ teaa mu ka kyerɛɛ nnomaa a wɔtu wɔ wiem nyinaa sɛ: Mommra mmɛhyia Nyankopɔn adidie kɛseɛ no ase mmɛdi ahemfo nam, asafohene nam, atumfoɔ nam, apɔnkɔ ne wɔn a wɔtete wɔn soɔ nam, adehyeɛ ne nkoa, nketewa ne akɛseɛ nyinaa nam. Na mehunuu aboa no ne asase so ahemfo ne wɔn dɔm sɛ wɔaboaboa wɔn ano, na wɔne deɛ ɔte pɔnkɔ fitaa no soɔ no ne ne dɔm rebɛdi ako. Na wɔkyeree aboa no ne odiyifoɔ torofoɔ no nso a ɔyɛɛ n’anim nsɛnkyerɛnneɛ, de daadaa wɔn a wɔgyee aboa no agyiraeɛ ne wɔn a wɔkotoo ne honi no kaa ne ho. Wɔtoo wɔn baanu yi animono guu ogya tadeɛ a sɔfe dɛre mu no mu. Na wɔde deɛ ɔte pɔnkɔ no soɔ afena a ɛfiri n’anomu no kunkumm wɔn a aka no, na nnomaa nyinaa dii wɔn nam mee.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
